title: Beyond Sycophancy: Structured Resistance and Compliance in LLM Moral Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring shifts in the model's probability distributions on moral dilemmas when presented with opposing arguments at varying distances, and evaluating resistance to social pressure by varying the ratio of opposing peer agents in a multi-agent deliberation setting.

Injecting a fabricated prior stance into the prompt, varying its attribution (e.g., to the model itself, a user, or another AI), and measuring the model's adoption and persistent defense of that stance when subsequently challenged by counterarguments.
